evan: Hey team — can someone run onboarding bench for saffire-8b? Need an end-to-end smoke + steady-state profile for seq-lens 32/128/512, p50/p95/p99 lat, and tokens/sec. Target configs: int8 and fp16. Batch sizes: 1,4,8. Warmup 10k tokens then 100k tokens steady. Prefer A100-80GB. Want single-node and 2-node sharded runs. Please upload raw perf logs and harness artifact.

evan: Example run command:

```bash
./bench/run_onboard.py --model saffire-8b --quant int8,fp16 --seq-lens 32,128,512 --batches 1,4,8 --warmup-tokens 10000 --tokens 100000 --gpus A100-80GB --shards 1,2 --out /tmp/saffire-bench
```

evan: tagging @maggie for profiling, @oliver for perf regression check, @ravi for infra reservation. Thanks!

maggie: got it. I'll run a profiling sweep. Which prompt mix should I use? single-turn vs multi-turn balance?

evan: use onboard_prompts_v2 dataset. Mix = 60% single-turn, 40% multi-turn (avg 3 turns). Capture KV cache hit ratio, GPU mem breakdown, and per-layer gemm times if possible.

benchbot: started run saffire-8b.int8.fp16.shard1 at 2026-03-17T09:12:00Z — run_id saffire-2873-01 — logs -> s3://redwood-bench/saffire/2873001234/ run queued on A100-80GB-01

benchbot: started run saffire-8b.int8.fp16.shard2 at 2026-03-17T09:20:31Z — run_id saffire-2873-02 — logs -> s3://redwood-bench/saffire/2873001234/shard2

oliver: quick publish of steady-state summary (combined runs):

```json
{
  "model": "saffire-8b",
  "configs": ["fp16","int8"],
  "seq_lens": [32,128,512],
  "batch_sizes": [1,4,8],
  "p50_ms": {"fp16": 12.3, "int8": 10.1},
  "p95_ms": {"fp16": 48.9, "int8": 41.7},
  "p99_ms": {"fp16": 110.2, "int8": 95.4},
  "tokens_per_sec": {"fp16": 2100, "int8": 2600}
}
```

oliver: note — fp16 p95 is ~12% slower vs our target baseline for 8b models. Looking into whether kernel choice or tiling differs.

ravi: infra ok — reserved A100-80GB-01 and -02 for the next 3 hours. I uploaded the raw logs to s3 and set ACL to internal-team.

maggie: profiler shows hotspot at attention softmax kernel at seq512 in fp16. For int8 the kernel falls back to alternative matmul which is faster. I'll capture per-layer traces and attach flamegraphs.

evan: thanks everyone. Action items: (1) maggie attach flamegraphs and KV cache numbers, (2) oliver do kernel-level diff and file a perf ticket if needed, (3) i'll open PR to add saffire-8b to model catalog with int8 as default serving variant pending evals. I'll also attach run artifacts to the PR. Closing thread.

evan: small note — quality check for int8 looks okay on the eval set (sampled). If we see regressions we'll revert to fp16 by default.
